summary: A message from Steve Bunch about when and where to hold the next Network Graphics Working Group meeting. After feedback on an earlier proposal for a May meeting in his lab, he reports that most people preferred mid to late summer. He responds to the three groups of comments.

plainLanguage.summary: Steve Bunch reports that people objected to a proposed May meeting and wanted more time. He suggests a July date and names the person expected to chair the meeting.

subtitle: Steve Bunch weighs feedback and proposes a summer date for the Network Graphics Working Group.

tldr.problem: An earlier proposal for a Network Graphics Working Group meeting on May 11 received strong objections.
tldr.mechanism: Steve Bunch groups the feedback into three preferences and proposes a later date that allows more time to prepare.
tldr.outcome: He proposes July 16, 1973, with James Michener as chair. The unit metadata lists RFC 474 as updating this notice.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 474 as updating RFC 396. The text is a meeting-date proposal and identifies James Michener as the expected chair.

sections.title: Three Views on the Meeting Date
sections.content: Steve Bunch had suggested in RFC 474 that the Network Graphics Working Group meet on May 11, 1973. Feedback fell into three groups: meet in late April or early May alongside the ANTS meeting, meet in mid to late summer (the majority view), or wait because there was nothing to discuss.
sections.plainLanguage: People gave three views: meet sooner, meet later, or do not meet yet. Most preferred a date in the summer.

sections.title: Why a Later Meeting Seems Better
sections.content:
Bunch says late April or early May is too soon. Although that timing would be convenient, some people have other commitments and may not have enough time to prepare.

He also rejects the idea that there is nothing to meet about, even considering his own limited current and planned needs. Mid to late summer seems best to him because everyone who contacted him objected strongly to May 11.
sections.plainLanguage: A sooner date would leave some people too little time to prepare. Bunch believes the group still has matters to discuss, so he favors a later meeting.

sections.title: Proposed Date and Meeting Roles
sections.content:
Bunch proposes July 16, 1973. He expects this to leave time for participants to read a forthcoming RFC by James Michener and to get answers about past meetings and committees.

Michener, the Network Graphics Group chairman, will chair the meeting. A recording secretary is expected to volunteer during the meeting. Bunch says his role has been and will probably remain clerical. He also corrects a phone number printed incorrectly in RFC 474.
sections.plainLanguage: Bunch proposes July 16 and says the extra time can help participants prepare. James Michener is expected to chair, while someone will volunteer to take notes.

references.text: RFC 474, the earlier meeting proposal referred to in the text.
